# VectraSyn

> Affordable, fast-turnaround digital services for small, medium and growing businesses: websites, apps, e-commerce, automation, and logo/branding. Website: https://vectrasyn.com. The site is available in English and Arabic (Modern Standard Arabic, right-to-left). Pricing is shown in INR (default), USD and AED.

## Site structure

- https://vectrasyn.com/ — Home: overview of the four core services, pricing preview, proof-of-work preview, booking CTA.
- https://vectrasyn.com/pricing — Full service menu with list price and final price (50% off) in INR, USD or AED, plus a "What's included" detail per service.
- https://vectrasyn.com/book — Selected services summary plus a video consultation booking calendar (Cal.com). No payment is taken on the site.
- https://vectrasyn.com/proof-of-work — Case study grid. All slots are placeholders marked "Case study coming soon".
- https://vectrasyn.com/about — Company story, how we work, payment terms, FAQ.
- https://vectrasyn.com/contact — Contact form and social links.

## Booking and social

- Book a video consultation: https://cal.com/vectrasyn/consultation
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/vectrasyn
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/vectrasyngroup

## Core services

- Websites — fast, mobile-friendly business websites.
- Apps — focused mobile or web apps.
- Automation — simple pipelines connecting business tools.
- Logo & Branding — original logo and brand files.
- E-commerce / WooCommerce — custom-quoted online stores.

## Pricing (list price -> final price, 50% off unless noted)

Final prices are Founding Client Rates, fixed for the first 10 clients across each service.

- Website Only: INR 36,000 -> 22,000 | USD 1,100 -> 550 | AED 4,000 -> 2,000
- Simple Pipeline: INR 10,000 -> 5,000 | USD 300 -> 150 | AED 1,100 -> 550
- Logo Design: INR 10,000 -> 5,000 | USD 400 -> 200 | AED 1,500 -> 750
- GBP Setup: INR 12,000 -> 6,000 | USD 300 -> 150 | AED 1,100 -> 550
- App Only: INR 70,000 -> 35,000 | USD 2,400 -> 1,200 | AED 8,800 -> 4,400
- E-commerce / WooCommerce (custom quote): INR 60,000-1,60,000 -> starting from 30,000-80,000 | USD 2,400-6,000 -> 1,200-3,000 | AED 9,000-24,000 -> 4,500-12,000
- Bundle 1: INR 50,000 -> 25,000 | USD 1,400 -> 700 | AED 5,200 -> 2,600
- Bundle 2: INR 100,000 -> 50,000 | USD 2,200 -> 1,100 | AED 8,200 -> 4,200
- Monthly Maintenance: INR 16,000 -> 8,000/mo | USD 360 -> 180/mo | AED 1,300 -> 650/mo

## What's included (selected)

- Website Only: standalone website build (4 pages), no automation included; mobile-friendly responsive layout; built on a modern React-based stack with domain and hosting managed through Cloudflare; launch, testing and handover included.
- Simple Pipeline: one connection from site/social/form to Google Sheets or Airtable.
- Bundle 1: website (4 pages) + automation (1 connection) + logo design + Google Business Profile setup; INR 3,000/yr domain and maintenance after year 1.
- Bundle 2: everything in Bundle 1 + up to 2 extra pages + WhatsApp Business (catalogue, barcode, payment gateway) + SEO/AEO/GEO setup + GA4 analytics + 100 printed visiting cards with scan code (Hyderabad-exclusive) + custom add-ons on request.
- E-commerce: product catalogue setup, payment gateway integration, store configuration; scoped per client.

## Payment terms

- 30% deposit on signing, 40% at the mid-build milestone, 30% on completion and handover.
- The deposit is non-refundable once the agreement is signed and the video consultation appointment is complete.
- If VectraSyn cannot fulfil the agreed scope, the client is refunded 70% of the amount paid.
- The first 2 months after launch include free bug fixes.

## Notes

- The brand mark is the VectraSyn icon with the "VectraSyn" wordmark.
- No client testimonials, client names, or performance metrics are published yet.
- A company address, phone number, LinkedIn page and WhatsApp number are not published yet.
